sources.title: Model Health ⎸ Lab-Grade Movement Analysis from Smartphone Video

sources.title: Model Health ⎸ Platform - Automated Biomechanical Insights
sources.snippet: Automated analysis modules Model Health's analysis turns biomechanical data into test-specific metrics and reports for the most common performance and clinical assessments, like peak joint angles, contact times, peak velocities, completion times, and number of repetitions.

sources.title: Model Health ⎸ SDK - Embed Motion Analysis in Your Product
sources.snippet: Integrate validated 3D motion analysis into your platform via our SDK. Available in Swift, TypeScript, and Python. From pilot to production without building biomechanics pipelines.
